findings.description: The separator condition was inverted when the code moved into get_help_spec: it now uses "; " when any_prefix_is_slash is false and " / " when it is true, which is the reverse of the original logic.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option whose spellings use a slash prefix, such as a boolean flag declared as "--shout/--no-shout", or any option without slash prefixes. Mechanism: the join separator is swapped, so slash-style options render with "; " and ordinary options render with " / ". Impact: the help output's left column is wrong for these options, and the regression is visible in every help page that lists them.
